title: The Horse Book
setting: A small bookstore and a home dining room.

characters.name: Omar
characters.look: Omar, a young man with short black hair and a blue shirt

characters.name: Nina
characters.look: Nina, a young woman with long brown hair and a yellow dress

sentences.en: Omar and Nina visit a small bookstore.
sentences.zh: 奥马尔和妮娜去逛一家小书店。
sentences.scene_prompt: Omar, a young man with short black hair and a blue shirt and Nina, a young woman with long brown hair and a yellow dress walk into a small cosy bookstore.

sentences.en: They see many young people reading there.
sentences.zh: 他们看到那里有很多年轻人在看书。
sentences.scene_prompt: Many young people read books between the shelves while Omar, a young man with short black hair and a blue shirt and Nina, a young woman with long brown hair and a yellow dress look around.

sentences.en: Nina needs a book with horse photos.
sentences.zh: 妮娜需要一本有马的照片的书。
sentences.scene_prompt: Nina, a young woman with long brown hair and a yellow dress holds a book with a photo of a horse on its cover.

sentences.en: She saw it at the library a week ago.
sentences.zh: 一个星期前她在图书馆见过这本书。
sentences.scene_prompt: Nina, a young woman with long brown hair and a yellow dress in a library looking at the same horse book on a shelf, shown as a memory picture.

sentences.en: Soon they are hungry, so they walk away.
sentences.zh: 很快他们饿了，于是就走了。
sentences.scene_prompt: Omar, a young man with short black hair and a blue shirt rubs his stomach as he and Nina, a young woman with long brown hair and a yellow dress walk away from the bookstore.

sentences.en: At home, Omar cooks fish for dinner.
sentences.zh: 回到家，奥马尔做鱼当晚饭。
sentences.scene_prompt: Omar, a young man with short black hair and a blue shirt cooks fish in a pan in a home kitchen.

sentences.en: Nina puts a light over the dining-room table.
sentences.zh: 妮娜在餐厅的桌子上方挂了一盏灯。
sentences.scene_prompt: Nina, a young woman with long brown hair and a yellow dress hangs a light over a table in a dining room.

sentences.en: Then she puts a bowl of oranges on it.
sentences.zh: 然后她在上面放了一碗橙子。
sentences.scene_prompt: Nina, a young woman with long brown hair and a yellow dress puts a bowl of oranges on the dining room table under the light.
